Changelog

cellprograms 0.2.0.9001 (development)

Metacells-to-programs vignette (2026-10-22)

  • New article vignettes/articles/metacells_to_programs.Rmd: the full downstream workflow after SuperCell 2.0 + mcRigor metacell construction — metacell counts -> donor pseudobulk (sum mode is lossless at the donor level) -> fit_celltype_programs(feature_scale = "logcounts") -> canonicalization -> stability -> CMP detection (planted coordinated pair recovered, private programs not called) -> program_sharing() -> project_programs_to_cells() back onto the original single cells (per-cell activities recover the planted donor gradient).

EB-CP tensor factorization and block EBMF (2026-10-21)

  • New fit_eb_cp(): greedy rank-1 empirical-Bayes CANDECOMP/PARAFAC factorization across cell types (genes x donors x cell types) with EBNM normal-means updates per mode (point-Laplace on gene and cell-type modes, normal on donors) and per-(cell-type, donor) residual variance — the tensor analogue of flashier var_type = 1. Components are selected by a winner’s-curse-proof held-out likelihood test on a donor-synchronous 50/50 split and refit on the full data with backfitting.
  • New eb_cp_from_fit(): runs the tensor factorization on the adjusted expression matrices (Y_used) of a cell_program_fit; the held-out split is stratified on the fit’s covariates by default (stratification is load-bearing: an unstratified split leaves residual covariate imbalance that the greedy pass spends components on).
  • New eb_cp_programs(): per-component cell-type memberships (member iff |W| >= 0.2 of the component maximum) and donor activities; components with >= 2 member cell types are coordination calls.
  • New fit_joint_block() / block_clusters(): joint block EBMF at expression or scores level (shared-first greedy + private pass), with block-mass-based membership extraction.
  • New benchmark suite benchmarks/coordination/: simulator with correlated-private decoys (priv_corr) and each-alone breadth families, six methods (pa_cc, node_cor, subspace_sum, gene_match, block_E, eb_cp) + oracle floor, scorer with Hungarian matching, resumable replicate harness, runtime/amplitude pilots, and the filled preregistration (benchmarks/coordination/PREREG.md, prereg-coord-v1).

SuperCell backend (2026-10-22)

  • New default R-native metacell path implementing the preregistered benchmark verdict (REPLACE): MetacellsByGroupsSuperCell(), OptimizeGammaSuperCell() and GetMetacellSuperCell() wrap SuperCell 2.0 (SCimplify_for_Seurat_v5, pinned GfellerLab/SuperCell@89b34c0) with the same grouping semantics, mcRigor QC and return structure as the SEACells trio. No Python/basilisk required, and the end-to-end tests run in the plain R test suite (the SEACells e2e stays CPMC_INTEGRATION-gated). target_metacells is reached by log-gamma bisection; OptimizeGammaSuperCell() optimizes native cells-per-metacell by the mcRigor score. The user-facing surface grows from 42 to 45 verbs.
  • MetacellsByGroupsSEACells() and the SEACells backend remain exported and unchanged.
  • mcRigor wrapper fix (both backends): .mcrigor_detect_group() now passes MC-prefix string labels named by cell id to mcRigor_DETECT. Integer codes are coerced to NA by DETECT’s named-membership filter at mcRigor c70cd6f and aborted with “Cannot find cells provided”; the string convention is what the benchmark validated. # cellprograms 0.2.0.9000 (development)

Metacell benchmark (2026-10-22)

  • Preregistered benchmark of SEACells vs SuperCell 2.0 (pure R) with mcRigor QC across 2 scales x 3 seeds x 4 granularities (benchmarks/metacell_comparison/). Verdict: REPLACE - SuperCell 2.0 + mcRigor is the default R-native metacell path (mean |ARI gap| 0.019 <= 0.05; mean relative fidelity gap 5.4% <= 10%; membership construction ~200x faster; downstream program fit is N- and method-insensitive). SEACells remains available and unchanged.

API streamlining (2026-10-21)

  • Eight internal helpers are no longer exported (still callable via cellprograms:::; nothing is deleted): program_metadata (derivable from program_loadings() column names), principal_angles (pairwise primitive behind align_programs() / match_programs()), cmp_scores, cmp_gene_overlap, cmp_context_association and cmp_nuisance_genes (components orchestrated by cmp_triage()), union_panel_loadings and ambient_program_scores (coordination machinery). The user-facing surface drops from 50 to 42 verbs.
  • The pkgdown reference index is reorganized from a flat 50-function list into 8 curated family sections (Data & simulation / Fit & canonicalize / Extract / Compare, align & share / Coordination & annotation / Metacells / Program plots / Coordination & sharing plots), following the mixOmics reference layout.

Bug fixes and hardening (2026-10-21 all-exports smoke sweep)

  • plot_cmp_network(): no longer crashes on CMP results computed with ambient = "none" — those results carry no ambient_score column (nothing was excluded), and the plot assumed it existed (setNames length mismatch). Nodes are now unflagged for ambient in that case.
  • Fit consumers fail closed on a non-canonicalized fit: program_summary(), program_metadata(), program_scores(), program_loadings(), top_genes(), assess_program_stability(), principal_angles(), sharing_spectrum(), align_programs() and match_programs() now abort with “run canonicalize_programs() first” instead of the opaque “argument is of length zero” (ncol(NULL) on the unpopulated scores list) or silently empty tables. Three entry points already had this guard (find_coordinated_programs(), project_programs_to_cells(), plot_variance_explained()); the message is now uniform across the API.
  • Regression test: every guarded consumer rejects a raw fit_celltype_programs() output with the fix named, and passes a canonicalized fit through unchanged.

Bug fixes and hardening (2026-10-20 edge-case segment)

  • OptimizeGammaSEACells(): gammas is now validated (positive integers) and deduplicated/sorted at entry — duplicate candidates previously produced identically named membership columns for mcRigor_OPTIMIZE.
  • .mc_get_group_ids() (both metacell entry points): fails closed when a group.by column is missing or contains NA — paste() previously rendered NA as the literal string "NA", silently lumping unassigned cells into a spurious group.
  • OptimizeGammaSEACells() membership coding: cells with NA membership labels in any candidate gamma are excluded with a warning before scoring; unique() previously counted NA as a level, inflating the degeneracy check and leaking NA codes into mcRigor.
  • .cebmf_use_python_env(): an existing directory without bin/python now aborts with the registered message instead of falling through to reticulate (file.exists() is TRUE for directories).
  • Regression test: the cebmf basilisk pip spec is checked for the invariants the CI shakedown established (no flag entries, no whitespace, == pins or commit-pinned direct references only).
  • Packaging: hdWGCNA removed from Suggests (never imported; design attribution lives in comments). Its presence broke every CI dependency solve — pak cannot resolve GitHub-only packages from CRAN/Bioconductor.
  • CI: workflow actions bumped to Node 24 majors (checkout v7, upload-artifact v7, github-script v9, upload-pages-artifact v5, deploy-pages v5); Node 20 was removed from runners on 2026-09-23. The drift issue now also auto-closes on a green workflow_dispatch run, not just scheduled runs.

Bug fixes and hardening (2026-10-20 cebmf basilisk segment)

  • The cebmf_torch backend’s basilisk environment was never constructible and the defect was masked by every audit run setting the venv option. Three fixes: the pip spec now pins numpy/scipy (which cebmf_ext imports directly and torch does not provide), the CPU torch wheel is selected via --extra-index-url as its own pip token (index flags are global pip options, not requirement syntax), and the commit-pinned cebmf_torch direct reference is written unspaced so the shell cannot split it when basilisk passes pip entries through system2 unquoted. The basilisk version-spec check is relaxed only while this one environment is created (it cannot parse PEP 508 direct references; the commit pin is fully reproducible). The env now builds and the backend fits through it with no option set.

Bug fixes and hardening (2026-10-19 implementation-review segment)

Full implementation review follow-through: 2 critical correctness fixes, 12 major fixes, and 50 minor fixes. Regression coverage for every fixed finding lives in tests/testthat/test-review-fixes.R and tests/testthat/test-artifact-genes.R.

Critical

  • GetMetacellSEACells(): multi-group soft-assignment matrices are now combined block-diagonally (one block per group) instead of row-binding group-local column indices, which crashed or silently misassigned cells to metacells when more than one group was processed.
  • cmp_context_association(): the context term is selected exactly through the model-matrix term assignment instead of a ^x prefix grep that also captured adjustment covariates whose names start with “x” (e.g. xsite). Covariates named y or .ctx are refused (reserved internal names).

Major

  • fit_celltype_programs(): within-cell-type constant genes no longer crash the gene filter under scale = TRUE; their non-finite column mass is treated as degenerate and the genes are dropped.
  • fit_celltype_programs(backend = "cebmf_torch") warns when a cell type’s fit exhausts maxit without converging (the flag was stored but never surfaced).
  • assess_program_stability() warns and skips cell types with fewer than 5 donors instead of crashing during resampling.
  • plot_program_scores() handles per-cell-type observation sets (union of donors, NA where a cell type was not observed) instead of requiring equal row counts; z-scoring is NA-aware.
  • plot_sharing_spectrum() rewritten: significance class (shared / n.s. / underpowered) drives a fixed colorblind-safe palette, q-values are carried in the pair labels, and >9 pairs no longer break the color scale.
  • plot_artifact_flags() detects any *_frac column set (not just the built-in screens) and accepts CMP-shaped flag tables.
  • union_panel_loadings() leaves zero-overlap or constant panel genes NA (with warnings) instead of aborting, and replays rank-deficient fixed covariate designs via least squares instead of crashing in solve().
  • project_programs_to_cells() refuses a feature_scale declaration that contradicts the fit’s recorded units (previously silently accepted).
  • flag_artifact_genes(): the V(D)J screen now also covers J/D segments, IGLL-family genes, and JCHAIN.
  • Metacells: max_iter documentation corrected (wrapped SEACells default is 20); use_sparse warns when set (ignored by the wrapped SEACells version); per-metacell QC columns are joined into the result metadata.
  • Metacell IO coercions use the non-deprecated CsparseMatrix form throughout: the pinned flashier’s .onLoad sets Matrix.warnDeprecatedCoerce = 2, under which the previous dgCMatrix coercions of readMM() output error out (exposed by the first CPMC_INTEGRATION=1 end-to-end run, which now passes).
  • withr moved from Suggests to Imports: withr::local_seed() is called unconditionally by the fitting code since the scoped-RNG fix.
  • OptimizeGammaSEACells() now works under Seurat v5: mcRigor’s buildmc aligns per-metacell sizes through AggregateExpression colnames, which mangle membership labels (digit-leading values gain a “g” prefix; “_” becomes “-”) and only undo the digit case — the "mc_<k>" labels used here never realigned, so every group failed with “No cell overlap between new meta data and Seurat object”. Membership is now integer-coded per gamma column (the same contract as the mcRigor_DETECT path) and gamma candidates whose membership collapses to a single metacell are dropped with a warning (NA in scores) instead of failing the whole group’s optimization.
  • MetacellsByGroupsSEACells() no longer crashes when SEACells collapses a group to fewer metacells than archetypes fitted (degenerate fits on weak structure): the soft-assignment matrix has one column per archetype and cannot be renamed to the realized metacell names, so it is dropped for that group with a warning instead of erroring with “length of Dimnames[[2]] is not equal to Dim[2]”.

Minor (selected)

  • All internal RNG is now scoped with withr::local_seed(); no set.seed() leaks into the user session.
  • plot_variance_explained() maps PVEs to programs through the flashbridge native-factor mapping and skips (with a warning) cell types whose PVE vector cannot be reconciled, instead of positionally truncating.
  • plot_context_association() omits confidence intervals for associations with a zero t statistic (previously infinite whiskers) and labels the context term plainly after the .ctx internal rename.
  • plot_program_scores() fails closed when an annotation data.frame lacks an observation_id column (previously a silent all-NA strip).
  • match_programs() documents that space only affects the subspace angles (factor-level matches are always loading-cosine based) and fails closed when space = "scores" has fewer than 2 shared observations.
  • as_mofacellular_input() aborts on composite-name collisions under the <cell_type>_<observation_id> scheme, on duplicate cell_counts keys, and on zero-observation cell types.
  • Metacell IO: missing counts-like layers warn or abort, dims are validated, and numeric-like cell names abort (they would be mangled by the Python bridge).
  • CMP machinery: sign-concordance ties and all-NA sign vectors no longer score deterministically; prepare_collectri() parses integer 0/1 mor correctly; NA mor edges are dropped with a warning; cmp_gene_overlap() is schema-stable on empty and single-member input.
  • Sharing/alignment: degenerate-program NA propagation fixed; sharing_spectrum() gains an explicit seed argument; the variance estimate reuses the sharing matrices (single computation, consistent panels); principal-angle p-value NA handling no longer biases the permutation null.

New features (2026-10-18 feature-completion segment)

  • Metacell construction is folded into cellprograms from the retired r_packages/cellprogramsMC sub-package: MetacellsByGroupsSEACells() (group-stratified SEACells metacells with mcRigor QC), OptimizeGammaSEACells() (mcRigor granularity selection), and GetMetacellSEACells() (result accessor). The basilisk Python environment is now created lazily on first use (internal .seacells_env(), same pattern as the cebmf backend), so basilisk stays in Suggests and installing cellprograms never requires basilisk, Python, Seurat, or mcRigor; the exported seacells_env object from the sub-package is retired (nothing in the project referenced it). Seurat, SeuratObject, and mcRigor are Suggests with explicit fail-closed guards; Matrix and methods move to Imports. Note: the basilisk environment is re-registered under cellprograms, so the first metacell run after this change rebuilds the SEACells conda environment (one-time, needs network).
  • fit_celltype_programs() gains backend = c("flashier", "cebmf_torch"). The cebmf_torch backend runs the pure-PyTorch cEBMF implementation (pinned upstream william-denault/cebmf_torch@34abac5) through the cebmf_ext adapter, with a registered numerical guard set (sebetahat floor 1e-4, tau precision cap 1e8, explicit seeding, seed-family fallback with diagnostics) and a strict mapping contract: the bridge never manufactures flashier-only quantities, so elbo, L_psd, F_psd, and F_lfsr are NULL on this backend and program_summary() reports elbo = NA. Fixed-mode covariates are refused on this backend (no fixed-loadings path); use the default covariate_mode = "residualize". Python resolution: options(cellprograms.cebmf_python_env = ...) (python binary or venv with cebmf_ext importable), else basilisk (pinned torch==2.7.1 CPU — the pin is load-bearing, 2.14.1+cpu diverges on inputs where 2.7.1+cpu is green), else a fail-closed error. No flashier-style fallback ladder: backend failures abort loudly per cell type.
  • fit_celltype_programs() gains var_floor = "none" | "vignette" | <positive scalar>: fix the residual SD instead of estimating it. "vignette" uses the flashier single-cell vignette’s floor, S = sd(log(Poisson(1/n) + 1)) with n the cell type’s donor count, drawn once per cell type at a fixed local seed (deterministic, fit-seed-independent). A var_floor-derived S is not mappable through flashier.utils::fit_ebmf(), so on the fast path the fit reroutes through flashier::flash() with a warning; the cebmf_torch backend passes S through as KNOWN noise. The default "none" preserves existing behavior exactly. Calibration evidence: CAND-13 demonstrator (reports/audit/E_programs/).
  • Covariate-audit patches (R2/F1-F4): gene-drop blocks now subset the projection-replay center/scale vectors to retained genes (F1); covariate_mode = "fixed" with center = FALSE is refused even when the combination arrives through a frozen preprocessing spec (F3); covariate terms referencing within-cell-type-constant variables — including interaction terms — are dropped instead of crashing model.matrix() (F4); aliased rank-deficient replay designs zero their NA coefficients at projection instead of propagating NaN activities (F2).

New features (spec v2 execution segment)

  • assess_cmp_stability() (CP-2): stability of coordinated multicellular programs under SYNCHRONIZED donor resampling. Donors are drawn once per replicate (optionally within donor-level donor_strata) and the identical donor set is applied to every cell type — independent per-type subsampling (assess_program_stability()) changes donor overlap arbitrarily and cannot answer whether the same donors support a CMP. Resampling is subsampling without replacement (subsample_frac, default 0.8): duplicated donor rows would pseudo-replicate the donor-level evidence the permutation null evaluates. donor_col promotes resampling to the biological donor when it differs from observation_ids (all of a donor’s observations are kept together; missing cell types/visits are never synthesized); visit_col is required when donors contribute > 1 observation, making the paired-observation estimand explicit. Each replicate reruns find_coordinated_programs() with the caller’s predeclared cmp_args and reports per-CMP membership recovery (Jaccard), assignment-ambiguity margins, sign concordance up to one global flip, donor-score concordance, cell-type survival, and CP-1-style failure accounting (valid_refits / failed_refits, conditional rates, NA on all-fail). When the reference fit yields no CMPs, stability is reported as ineligible rather than zero.

Audit remediations

  • find_coordinated_programs(): missing donor scores (NA) are no longer silently converted into top ranks. Rank transformation and strata residualization keep NA donors as NA, cross-cell-type correlations use pairwise-complete donors, edge n reports the pairwise-complete donor count for each program pair, and a warning lists programs with missing scores. Previously, rank()’s default na.last=TRUE manufactured fake top-scoring donors, which either destroyed detection power (donor-specific missingness) or inflated significance (missingness shared across programs); a planted pair with 20% missingness could be missed entirely with no warning. Regression tests: tests/testthat/test-cmp-missingness.R.

Remediation queue (2026-10-18): CAND-01, CAND-05, CAND-07, D-2a, CAND-03+D-3b, CAND-12

  • assess_program_stability() (CAND-01/CP-1, P1): subsample refit failures are now counted and reported (fit$stability$valid_refits/failed_refits, warning on any failure) with a per-replicate replicate_log (status, error class/message, elapsed time, sampled observations and factor counts per cell type, matching eligibility). recovery_freq keeps its LEGACY meaning (unconditional hit fraction over requested iterations, n_hit / n_boot); the new conditional_recovery_freq is defined over SUCCESSFUL refits (n_hit / valid_refits) — previously the silent denominator was n_boot, so a 30% refit-failure rate read as a 30% recovery loss with zero user-facing signal, and an all-fail run was indistinguishable from zero stability. All-fail now yields NA rates with a distinct warning; per-program n_hit and n_eligible added. Subsampled refit objects now carry consistent observation_ids/sample_metadata/dims (previously stale full-data values).
  • find_coordinated_programs() (CAND-05, P2): CMP member orientation now propagates along the linking edges that formed the CMP (product of edge signs along the path from the reference member). Chain-joined members previously inherited the sign of the direct reference–member edge from the full edge table — which can be a non-linking noise edge, i.e. a random +/- that propagated into cmp_scores(), annotate_cmp_tf() and cmp_triage() direction calls.
  • program_sharing() (D-2a/D-2c, P1): matches= references are validated (unknown programs abort informatively instead of crashing in the mashr layer) and every forced-matches call warns that the “shared” label counts top genes ACTIVE (lfsr < thresh) in >= 2 conditions — which independent loadings can also reach at high loading SNR (audit D-2a: 30/30 false “shared” for forced independent pairs at loading SE 0.125, while mashr’s own mixture put 96% weight on the identity pattern, p_all_shared ~ 0.001); p_all_shared is the diagnostic. The classification rule itself is unchanged pending a registered benchmark of any replacement.
  • Matching-step documentation (CAND-07, P1): the gene-permutation null’s exchangeability caveat is now stated where matching q-values are produced (mirroring cmp-interpret.R): block-correlated genes inflate false matches (audit D-1: 67.0% type-I under block equicorrelation 0.55 vs 2.0% iid). The null itself is UNCHANGED — a registered mini-benchmark (null calibration at block equicorrelation + planted-truth power) precedes any null change.
  • as_cell_program_data() (CAND-03, P2): rejects ALL non-finite entries (NA/NaN/Inf) with a count-bearing abort; Inf previously passed the NA-only check and crashed validate/fit with an opaque “missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed”.
  • .greedy_match() (D-3b, P2): non-finite similarities are demoted to “unmatched” with a warning instead of crashing on max() of an NA-bearing matrix.
  • fit_celltype_programs() + assess_program_stability() (CAND-12, P2): the full frozen preprocessing_spec is stored on the fit (not just its digest) and stability refits REPLAY it through the MR-0 fail-closed checks; feature_scale joined the MR-0 conflict list and is passed through in legacy-path refits (previously silently “unknown” in refit manifests).

cellprograms 0.2.0

Stage B: frozen preprocessing and cell-level projection

  • freeze_preprocessing() (MR-0): resolve the feature panel and adjustment decisions once into a content-addressed specification (cell_program_preproc_spec, sha256 digest); refit any cohort carrying the same genes with fit_celltype_programs(preprocessing_spec = ...), which replays the spec fail-closed (conflicting explicit arguments are refused, and the spec’s digest is recorded in the fit’s preprocessing provenance).
  • project_programs_to_cells() (MR-1): project fitted programs onto individual cells. Query expression is adjusted with the fit’s recorded preprocessing (residualization coefficients, centering, scale), activities are inferred against the frozen gene loadings via flashier.utils::project_factor_activity(), and raw activities are canonicalized with the same RMS/sign multipliers as the donor scores. Requires a canonicalized fit with declared feature_scale; fits with residualized covariates require donors + sample_metadata, and the rebuilt covariate design must match the fit’s design columns exactly.
  • fit_celltype_programs() gains feature_scale (declared measurement units, recorded in the fit manifest and required for projection) and preprocessing_spec (MR-0 replay); fits now record a preproc_replay block per cell type so the exact adjustment can be replayed on query data.
  • New roadmap: reports/STAGE_B_ROADMAP.md (MR-0..MR-4 spec, staged main-run costs, registration drafts, gates).

Backend synchronization (Stage A)

  • Ordinary EBMF fits now delegate to flashier.utils::fit_ebmf() and canonicalization uses flashier.utils::standardize_factors(scaling = "rms"), with numerical parity verified to machine precision against the previous direct flashier::flash() backend. The public workflow, output fields, and scientific results are unchanged. flashier, ebnm, and flashier.utils move to Imports (R >= 4.3 required); the fixed-covariate path (covariate_mode = "fixed") and degenerate fits remain on the legacy backend. Set options(cellprograms.use_flashier_utils = FALSE) to force the legacy backend. See reports/SYNC_ROADMAP.md for the version pair, parity evidence, and rollback plan.

New features

  • find_coordinated_programs() and the CMP toolkit: coordinated multicellular program detection from donor-level program scores with within-strata permutation FWER control, plus cmp_scores(), ambient_program_scores(), annotate_cmp_lr(), annotate_cmp_themes(), cmp_gene_overlap(), cmp_context_association(), annotate_cmp_tf() (CollecTRI footprints via prepare_collectri()), cmp_triage(), and cmp_nuisance_genes().
  • program_sharing(): post-hoc shared-vs-specific assessment of matched programs across cell types with ‘mashr’ — permutation-calibrated loading matching, greedy agglomeration into disjoint matched groups, CorShrink-style null-correlation estimation (z_thresh configurable), and per-gene lfsr calls. Fits now store loading posterior SDs (F_psd/L_psd).
  • Artifact-gene masking: artifact_gene_sets (V(D)J, genotype-marker, sex sets), artifact_genes(), flag_artifact_genes(), and fit-time exclude_genes in fit_celltype_programs() (applied before variable-gene selection).

Bug fixes and robustness

  • program_sharing() handles degenerate real-data fits: numerically degenerate programs (noise-floor loadings; fixed factors with collapsed posterior SDs) are excluded from matching, and zero-SD point-laplace posteriors are floored relative to each condition’s loading scale instead of tripping mashr’s zero check.
  • simulate_pseudobulk() no longer fails with custom cell_types under the “mixed” and “same_genes_independent” scenarios (shared-program objects are created by the first present member instead of a hardcoded cell type).

Documentation and infrastructure

  • Full roxygen2 documentation: man/ pages for all exported functions with runnable examples; NAMESPACE is now roxygen-managed.
  • R-CMD-check CI (ubuntu + macOS) and a pkgdown site skeleton.
  • Quickstart vignette and a precomputed real-data case-study article.

Benchmarks

  • benchmarks/cmp_detection/: pre-registered v1.1/v1.2 confirmations of the frozen CMP caller (max_factors = 30 upstream; held-out seeds 1051-1100, all 7 criteria passed) and dev verdicts for four challenger arms (joint-subspace rejected; two-stage identical to winner; Cauchy closest miss; EB shrinkage no-op).

Cross-cohort replication case study (CP-5, 2026-10-19)

  • New evaluated article vignettes/articles/cross_cohort_replication.Rmd: an end-to-end replication workflow on a three-cohort simulated fixture (conserved outcome-linked program, cohort-specific program, nuisance-only batch effect) orchestrating existing exports only — no new API. Shows the fixed-basis pathway (project_programs_to_cells(), learned transform applied) versus the de-novo pathway (freeze_preprocessing() + independent refit + match_programs()), with predeclared same-sign-as-discovery replication rules, abstention accounting (attempted/projected/matched/ineligible/replicated denominators), three negative controls (200-fold permuted outcome at null ~0.05; scrambled gene IDs abstain loudly; batch-only effect does not replicate as biology), and a leave-one-cohort-out check in which the cohort-specific program correctly abstains. confirm_programs_across_cohorts() is deliberately NOT exported: no multi-user need is proven.
